lines.zh: 測試板很厚，訊號要從底面一路穿到頂面的晶片。
lines.en: A test board is thick, and the signal has to travel from the bottom side up to the chip on top.

lines.zh: 導通孔用不到的那一截叫殘樁，它會在某個頻率把訊號吃掉，眼圖整個閉上了。
lines.en: The unused part of a via is a stub. At one frequency it swallows the signal, and the eye closes.

lines.zh: 把兩邊的殘樁背鑽掉，損耗曲線上的缺口就不見了。
lines.en: Back-drill both stubs and the notches in the loss curve are gone.

lines.zh: 再換成低損耗的板材，眼睛就張開了。
lines.en: Switch to a low-loss laminate and the eye opens.

lines.zh: 速率拉到 112 G，改用四階調變，三個眼都很小。
lines.en: Go to 112 gigabits with four-level signalling: three eyes, all small.

lines.zh: 打開接收端的等化，眼睛又張開一些。
lines.en: Turn on the receiver equaliser and the eyes open a little.

lines.zh: 另一個難題是電源。電流一跳，電壓就往下掉。
lines.en: The other problem is power. When the current steps, the voltage sags.

lines.zh: 目標阻抗等於電壓乘上容許的漣波，再除以電流的跳升量，這裡是兩百四十微歐姆。
lines.en: Target impedance is voltage times allowed ripple, divided by the current step: 240 micro-ohms here.

lines.zh: 加大電容，撐住慢的那一段；
lines.en: Bulk capacitors hold up the slow part;

lines.zh: 增加電源接腳、降低電感，撐住快的那一段；
lines.en: more power pins cut the inductance and hold up the fast part;

lines.zh: 中間再用中電容和高頻電容接力。
lines.en: mid and high-frequency capacitors cover the middle.

lines.zh: 電流加到一千安培，目標阻抗只剩四十幾微歐姆，又不夠了。
lines.en: At a thousand amps the target drops below fifty micro-ohms, and it is not enough again.

lines.zh: 訊號要走得乾淨，電要送得穩，這就是測試板在做的事。
lines.en: A clean path for the signal and a stiff rail for the power: that is the job of a test board.

lines.zh: 用 Claude Opus 5.5 做的，直接在瀏覽器裡就能玩。
lines.en: Built with Claude Opus 5.5 — it runs live in your browser.
